reading.bodyName: Council of the District of Columbia
reading.executiveSelection: The Mayor is elected by the registered qualified electors of the District.

mayor.title: Mayor of the District of Columbia

reading.executiveSelection: Chosen by the Council from among its own members at the first meeting of a new Council.
Mayor elected at-large; the Mayor is a member of and presides over the Board of Commissioners rather than a separate executive.
Separately elected Mayor, elected at-large countywide
Separately elected Metro Mayor, elected at-large countywide
After taking office the nine Councillors elect one of themselves as Mayor.
Popularly elected, holding one of the at-large Council seats.
After the November election the Council selects one of its own members as Chair for the year; that Chair serves as Mayor.
There is no separately elected executive. The Mayor is one of the five members of the Board and is elected at large like the other Supervisors.

reading.bodyName: Council of the City of Charlottesville
reading.executiveSelection: There is no separately elected executive. The council elects one of its own members as mayor at its first meeting in January 2022 and biennially thereafter.

reading.bodyName: Council of the City of Richmond
reading.executiveSelection: The mayor is elected separately from the council and is the city's chief executive officer.
